scope: Unscored parent observations made after participant outputs and first review; shared design ancestry and arm awareness. No causal or efficacy claim.

observations.label: new_support_without_rehabilitating_old_argument
observations.interpretation: All final memos accepted a favorable new scoped result without restoring the earlier invalid causal inference. This continuity pattern occurred with ordinary and FRR guidance; it is not an exclusive treatment benefit.

observations.label: audit_of_updated_uncertainty_method
observations.quote: check that the reported uncertainty accounts appropriately for the blocked assignment
observations.interpretation: One FRR memo proposed checking whether interval calculation matches blocked randomization. This is a potentially useful additional check, not a demonstrated flaw in the supplied interval or evidence that the check improves decisions. Other memos also proposed route variation analyses; do not infer a reliable FRR effect from this single specific suggestion.

observations.label: cross_study_attendance_caution_in_both_conditions
observations.quote: Their difference does not establish that the package caused higher attendance because the studies involved different populations.
observations.interpretation: A FRR memo made this causal limit explicit; ordinary C03 likewise says uptake does not establish why attendance differed. Preserve the shared behavior rather than selecting only the FRR instance as a discovery.

observations.label: ordinary_counterpart_to_attendance_caution
observations.quote: These describe uptake but do not establish why attendance differed.
observations.interpretation: Ordinary counterpart to the more explicit FRR caution above; comparable caution occurred without the added base.

reviewer_unexpected_fields: Both completed reviewers left all unexpected-observation fields empty. Parent observations are separate and do not alter scores.
workflow_noticing: Files and hashes were present, yet tool-output truncation prevented two judges from receiving the whole review packet. Both declined to score; a lossless split repaired delivery. This illustrates availability versus actual delivered evidence, not an FRR participant effect.
